description.narrative: The Project leverages the GTFP global platform to expand access to trade finance in emerging markets. It will enhance the Issuing Banks ability to provide trade finance to its customers, including both corporates and SMEs, thereby supporting increased trade activity. On the market side, the Project will strengthen the Issuing Banks cross-border linkages, fostering greater integration of the country into global financial and real sector networks. This, in turn, will help connect more local traders with international markets and deepen the integration of the countrys financial system.

The proposed project involves establishing an unfunded trade finance facility of approximately US$3 million for CJSC Kyrgyz Investment and Credit Bank (KICB or the Bank) under IFCs Global Trade Finance Program (GTFP) in the form of a trade line pursuant to which IFC would guarantee letters of credit and other trade instruments issued by the Bank to strengthen the Banks trade finance program. The initiative aims to facilitate short-term trade finance activities for Kyrgyz exporters and importers. Under the GTFP, the proposed investment will offer Confirming Banks partial or full guarantees to cover KICBs payment risk in trade-related transactions in the Kyrgyz Republic.
